assets.note: Muted looping hero for the CLEAN door. A city-wide gathering with hands raised, in daylight. Replaced an evening loop that measured roughly half the brightness and half the sharpness, which fought CLEAN's light register. Highlights were then pulled down: the sky as shot sat around the same luminance as the white page ground, so the band dissolved into it and the white above read as grey. The correction is exposure only, applied to the highlights, and recovers what the camera overexposed. Midtones, skin tones and colour are as captured. Do not restyle it further.

The EVERY1 mark, commissioned from the family grammar (Brand Guide §11, v5.8): heavy DM Sans caps as outlines, hairline rule with a single Flame tick, endorsement line, and the 1 built to stand alone at avatar scale. Until approved, EVERY1 surfaces carry the parent wordmark beside BURN.

The School of the Local Church academic seal (Brand Guide §11, v5.8): a shield bearing the Lion of Judah, ringed with the School's name, single colour, with masters for print, blind emboss, and wax. Until approved, certificates close with the two signatures and the letterhead rule alone.

Per-door capture libraries (Brand Guide §11, v5.8). RTMC: night altar calls, the host city by day, the host church serving, the empty venue. EVERY1: one-to-one moments away from any stage, the handoff, vertical 9:16 first. SLC: the classroom, the materials, the credential moment. Today all three doors draw from one conference.
